blocks.text: Budgeting and resource management involve planning how money, time, and other resources will be used in a business. A budget helps entrepreneurs estimate costs, set prices, and manage income and expenses effectively. Proper resource management ensures that materials, skills, and tools are used efficiently without waste. In digital businesses, good budgeting and resource planning help maintain profitability and support long-term success.
